body:
Source: GitHub issue #905 (bug, P1-high, area:review). Re-verified on main @ 982adee7: packages/prosecute/lib/tier.mjs:147-154, the rails-deny-path loop inside classifyTrustRootTier, iterates `tickets` and calls globMatch(glob, path) for every ticket.rails entry without ever reading ticket.completed. Completed tickets T37 and T38 (completed: true) declare packages/** as a rail, so classifyTrustRootTier reported isTrustRootTier:true (reasons citing T37/T38) for any change under packages/, forcing the signed cross-model record-cross-model ceremony on ordinary package bugfixes. packages/rails-guard/lib/ci/rail-freeze.mjs already honours the T36 completion lifecycle (`if (ticket.completed === true) continue;` at line 142, and again in its sanctionedAdditions logic); the two gates disagreed about which rails are live.

Package layout: `packages/prosecute` contains bin/adlc-prosecute.mjs (the CLI entry: tier-check, record-cross-model, etc., and where loadTicketsForTier assembles the ticket table classifyTrustRootTier is fed) and lib/tier.mjs, which holds the pure classifyTrustRootTier({changedFiles, tickets}) classifier. lib/cross-model.mjs, lib/attestation-store.mjs, lib/schema.mjs, and lib/run.mjs are unrelated P5 machinery outside this bug's surface. Tests run via `npm test -w packages/prosecute` from the worktree root (or `node --test packages/prosecute/test/*.test.mjs`). packages/prosecute/test/tier.test.mjs, tier-merge-base.test.mjs, and tier-completed-ticket-merge.test.mjs already cover classifyTrustRootTier's and loadTicketsForTier's other surfaces and are not rails; any of them can hold new coverage, or a sibling file.

loadTicketsForTier (bin/adlc-prosecute.mjs) unions tickets read from the base branch tip and from the worktree/HEAD ticket store, deliberately widening-only (a ticket added after the branch point still contributes rails). Two design layers compose: (1) mergeTicketsById merges same-id duplicate ticket records across sources BEFORE classification, with the FIRST source (base tip) winning for `completed` and every source's `rails` unioned onto the surviving record; (2) classifyTrustRootTier then filters the resulting, already-deduplicated array per-object on `completed === true`. Layer 1 fixes the case where a branch predates a ticket's completion on the base and still carries a stale, not-completed copy of it — without layer 1, that stale HEAD copy independently contributed its rails even after the base tip completed the ticket, since layer 2 alone only reads whichever single object it is given. Layer 1's base-tip precedence also preserves the existing security property: a HEAD-only edit claiming `completed: true` cannot self-exempt a ticket that is still active at the base tip, because the base-tip copy is listed first and wins.

Fix design: mergeTicketsById (bin/adlc-prosecute.mjs) groups the base-tip, worktree/HEAD, and (if present) --dir ticket arrays by id, in that precedence order, keeping the first occurrence's scalar fields (completed included) and unioning `rails` across every occurrence of that id. classifyTrustRootTier itself (tier.mjs:147) is unchanged from the original #905 fix: inside its `for (const ticket of ...)` loop, a ticket is skipped entirely (its rails globs never evaluated) when `ticket.completed === true` — a strict boolean check, matching rail-freeze.mjs:142's reading. classifyTrustRootTier's signature and return shape ({isTrustRootTier, reasons}) are unaffected; a ticket with rails matching a changed path and no `completed` field (undefined), or `completed: false`, continues to tier exactly as before. Documentation impact: `packages/prosecute/README.md`, `docs/tools/prosecute.md`, and `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/prosecute.mdx` are hand-maintained mirrors (never auto-regenerated) that should each state that a completed ticket's rails no longer count toward trust-root tiering, matching rail-freeze's T36 lifecycle, and that this holds even when a branch predates the completion.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 A ticket with `completed: true` and rails `["packages/**"]` does not tier a `packages/foo/lib/x.mjs` change (isTrustRootTier: false, reasons: []) when no other tier surface applies. verify: `node --test packages/prosecute/test/tier.test.mjs`
- AC2 The same ticket object with `completed` omitted (or `completed: false`) does tier the identical change (isTrustRootTier: true, reasons includes the rails deny-path reason). verify: `node --test packages/prosecute/test/tier.test.mjs`
- AC3 A completed ticket's rails are skipped even when a different, non-completed ticket in the same `tickets` array also declares rails matching the same path — the change still tiers via the non-completed ticket's reason, showing the fix filters per-ticket rather than short-circuiting the whole loop. verify: `node --test packages/prosecute/test/tier.test.mjs`
- AC4 Existing tier.test.mjs and tier-merge-base.test.mjs suites stay green unmodified; neither has an existing case exercising a completed ticket. verify: `npm test -w packages/prosecute`
- AC5 Documentation updated in all three places. verify: `grep -c "completed" packages/prosecute/README.md docs/tools/prosecute.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/prosecute.mdx` (each >= 1)
- AC6 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally before review)
- AC7 A branch cut before a ticket completes on the base, carrying its own stale not-completed copy of that ticket, does not tier a change touching that ticket's rail once the base tip has completed it. verify: `node --test packages/prosecute/test/tier-completed-ticket-merge.test.mjs`
- AC8 A HEAD-only claim of `completed: true` on a ticket still active at the base tip does not exempt it — the base-tip copy's `completed: false`/undefined still wins. verify: `node --test packages/prosecute/test/tier-completed-ticket-merge.test.mjs`
- AC9 A rail present only in the HEAD copy of a duplicate ticket id (not yet synced to the base tip) is still honoured — rails union across duplicate copies, only `completed` takes base-tip precedence. verify: `node --test packages/prosecute/test/tier-completed-ticket-merge.test.mjs`

Scope boundary: this ticket does not modify rail-freeze.mjs (already correct, and cited here only as the existing precedent the fix matches), and does not address issues #904/#903/#902 (the observed symptomatic PRs) beyond fixing the classifier and ticket-merge bugs they exposed. Because this fix lives under packages/prosecute/, an ENFORCEMENT_PREFIXES surface, the resulting change is itself trust-root tier under the existing, unmodified classifier rules and requires the cross-model record-cross-model ceremony before merge.
title: prosecute: tier-check must skip rails of completed tickets, including stale worktree copies
